limitations: Read-only code/evidence review with focused offline checks. No Minecraft client/server was launched, no complete functional/gameplay suite was replayed and no normal production rebuild was performed by the reviewer. Only inspection helpers were freshly compiled under this review directory.

Code inspection concentrated on the specified release risks and retention machinery rather than a formal proof of every line or arbitrary future modpack. The 226 cases, 65 profiles and 68,071 checks describe verified original archives, not new native executions.

The older seventeen-edge repair-prefix policy retains explicitly source-reviewed/native-qualified new-method additions rather than claiming independently exact body equivalence for every added method. I examined the bounded policy and actual risk paths, but did not recompile every historical production revision. Both final compiled transitions were independently re-executed.

Remote and installation acceptance remains representative 26.3 Fabric; carried-item disconnect is the measured branch. No all-loader/WAN, separate pending-mutation-disconnect, arbitrary controller hardware, resource-pack or resolution guarantee is supplied.

The Accessories beta.48 no-SIU control uses the same fixture manifest, NeoForge 21.1.252 and failing beta.48 bytes/symbol. Its launcher additionally stages the byte-identical extracted beta.48 as a root jar; the SIU attempt stages five upstream roots and loads beta.48 nested in Aether. This supports the documented same-failure observation, not complete classloading/root-cause equivalence or beta.48 functional acceptance. Advertised beta.54 acceptance is separately proven.

Visual inspection sampled the two named enchanting-book frames. Other populated/active layouts and GUI geometry retain their original native checks and explicit limits; this review is not a new exhaustive visual-capture campaign.
Packaged provenance is attribution evidence rather than a legal opinion. Publication destinations and commit/tag/push/publish actions need separate later authorization.
mutations: Only files under this independent-review directory were created. Canonical source, jars, docs, raw evidence, git state and publication were not changed.
